decision: Measure whether a continuously evolving coupled HICAR state becomes statistically stationary under one repeated 24-hour REA-L forcing and calendar cycle after restoring horizontal-wind state advancement.

model_interval.forcing_semantics: Every cycle reuses the same immutable 25 hourly REA-L records.
model_interval.calendar_semantics: Each exact-end restart is copied and only its scalar time coordinate is relabelled to the interval start. All atmospheric, cloud, PBL, snow, soil, and scheduler-phase state continues without reset.

execution.domain: 701x701 Alpine bridge at 200 m with 80 levels
execution.source_change: Apply the already-computed adjusted horizontal u/v tendency in domain_t.apply_forcing.
execution.physics: Morrison + YSU + Noah-MP + revised MM5 + RRTMGP

restart_interpretation.criterion: Each branch must pass the hash-bound HICAR restart integration tolerance on a different node allocation.
restart_interpretation.exact_reproducibility: Reported as a diagnostic, not assumed across preemptible allocations.
restart_interpretation.noise_floor: The corrected-wind cross-node continuation gate defines the restart/allocation perturbation floor. Repeated-day contraction must be interpreted relative to it.
restart_interpretation.reason: Preemptible jobs may relocate. A same-node restart check is insufficient for the intended workflow.

interpretation.primary_target: statistical equilibration to a periodically forced attractor
interpretation.not_assumed: pixelwise convergence to a deterministic 24-hour limit cycle
interpretation.reason: Resolved small-scale turbulent circulations may remain chaotic even when phase-conditioned moments and slow stores are stationary.
interpretation.production_scope: mechanism diagnosis only; an artificial repeated day cannot qualify real multi-day skill or a production spin-up length

equilibration_rule.slow_store_monotonic_trend: none exceeding its absolute threshold over the final three cycles
equilibration_rule.full_field_rule: Report full-field day-to-day RMSE and spatial correlation, but do not fail statistical equilibration solely because chaotic small-scale structures do not phase-lock.

result.wind_interpretation: All prescribed wind thresholds pass for cycle 1 to 2 and remain far below threshold thereafter. Two consecutive passing atmospheric transitions confirm a statistically stationary wind response by 48 hours for this case.
result.coupled_interpretation: The complete coupled state did not equilibrate within seven days. Domain-mean soil-column water increased on every transition and still gained 2.30304875120915 kg m-2 from cycle 6 to 7; soil-temperature and soil-water boundary RMSE also remained above threshold.
